grades.quote: During the execution of a floating-point instruction, multiple floating-point exceptions can be generated at the same time.
grades.reason: Acknowledges simultaneous exceptions but provides no rule for selecting which exception is reported.

grades.quote: Regarding the exponent field as an unbounded rounding of the intermediate result, when the absolute value of the result obtained exceeds the maximum finite number of the target format, an overflow exception will be notified.(This exception sets both inexact exception and flag bit)
grades.reason: Describes overflow occurring with inexact, but gives no exception-selection rule. The text does not identify an ISA.
Discusses counter behavior across traps, not selection among competing exceptions.
Describes vector compression and its restrictions, not exception priority or selection.
